overview: Discovery of legacy state and phased migration to the selected platform with validated rollback and reconciliation. The scope is built around workload inventories, dependency maps and cloud account permissions, producing landing-zone design, migration wave plan and cutover evidence. A customer-named cloud platform owner approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is application dependency and rollback verification.
